title: Al-Ma'un 107:4-7 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y1 lesson 48 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Ma'un 107:4-7 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 48. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ (٤) ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ (٥) ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ (٦) وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ (٧)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: So woe to those who pray
[But] who are heedless of their prayer -
Those who make show [of their deeds]

keywords.def: small things people need, like a cup or a pencil

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Ma'un 107:4-7 with the teacher.
Listening turns: today's group says 107:4-7 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: say it softly 3 times looking, 3 times without.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Lend or share something small at home today, like a pencil or a toy.

options: show off and refuse to lend small things
questions.a: A) show off and refuse to lend small things. 107:6 to 7: 'Those who make show [of their deeds] and withhold [simple] assistance.'

questions.q: Think again: Is it enough just to pray, or does Allah also want us to pray with our hearts and be kind to people?
questions.a: Allah wants both: careful prayer for Him alone, and kindness like lending small things (107:4 to 7).
